articles.title: Complex OAS residency rules key to court decision leaving retiree with benefit cut almost in half
articles.excerpt: The residency rules for claiming Old Age Security are essential to determining whether someone receives a full or partial OAS pension at retirement, or whether they receive it at all.
articles.author: Rudy Mezzetta

articles.title: The 4% withdrawal rule for retirees is dead. Long live the 4.7% rule
articles.excerpt: My husband and I started working in 2006, invested enough to retire in 2015, and have been living the financial independence retire early (FIRE) life for the past decade.
articles.author: Kristy Shen

articles.title: What it’s like to retire in an era of high inflation
articles.excerpt: The cliché of the poor senior on a fixed income is way overdone. But inflation does bite hard when you’re retired.
articles.author: Rob Carrick
